ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTDECLARATION THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTDECLARATION(attimesreferredtoasthe "Declaration”or“Agreement"), made as of the 15th day of October, 2021, by East End Gun Hill LLC, New York limited liability company, having an address c/o 725 East Gun Hill Road, Bronx, New York 10467 (at times referred to as the“Owner”or“Declarant"). WITNESSETH: thereon, in the Borough and County of the Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 725 East Gun Hill Road, Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 4 in Block 4657 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel A Land," said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Building,” and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively referred to as “Parcel A", and the Owner in its capacity as the current owner of Parcel A, and its successors and assigns, including the contract vendee forParcel A, shall be referred to herein at times collectively as the“Parcel A Owner"); WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough and County of the Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 743 East Gun Hill Road, Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 1 in Block 4657 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein referred to as the “Parcel B Land,”" said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, being herein referred to as the "Parcel B Building,”and the Parcel B Land, the Parcel B Building and any future replacements thereof being herein collectively referred to as“Parcel B”, and Owner in its current capacity as the owner of Parcel B, and its successors and assigns, including the contract vendee for Parcel B, shall be referred to herein at times collectively as the *Parcel B Owner", and at times the Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner are referred to herein individually as “Party" or collectively, as the “Parties"); WHEREAS, Owner is presently in contract to sell both Parcel A and Parcel B subject to the terms of this Agreement, and it is intended that the contract vendee of Parcel B will construct a new building (said new building on Parcel B, including any Rebuilding thereof, shall hereinafter be referred to as the “New Developer Building") on Parcel B with bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Parcel A Land, if the Parcel A Land were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), the difference being the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are available for transfer pursuant to the ZoningResolution;
